[SWS_IdsM_01305] NULL-Pointer valid for parameter for Timestamp-Pointer
Upstream requirements: RS_Ids_00630
⌈For an IdsMExternalEventId, when IdsMEventEnableTimestampReporting
is False and the IdsMExternalEventId is in range 0x8000 - 0xFFFE, IdsM shall
offer a service interface for reporting the security event with a possibility to provide
NULL_PTR to the timestampPtr argument as specified in [SWS_IdsM_91044] IdsM
Service_{EventName}⌋
